notes.note: Leader blocks verified in 0731.bla. Block A (#0.3-32 and #0.37-66, MessWinSet +r2) and block B (#0.72-86, +71+r1) use the Pt_Chara_Check order: Zero, OOO, Mebius, W, Taro, Den-O, Seven, Black RX, Ultraman, Rider 1, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00. So #0.49/50 Seven, #0.51/52 RX, #0.53/54 Ultraman, #0.55/56 Rider 1, #0.57/58 Nu, #0.59/60 Zeta, #0.61/62 God, #0.63/64 Wing Zero, #0.65/66 00. Echoes Belial's 'I'll bury you' (story_160). Sentence runs across the pair; cut at the matching point. The '-na' and plain endings get two near-identical renderings.
Speaker Ultraman Belial (CHARA_NAME 141), confirmed in script.
Speaker Dinosaur Greeed (CHARA_NAME 223); polite register kept light. 'Them' = the heroes.

#0.72-86 = block B (+71+r1), same order as block A: #0.77 Den-O (Momotaros, rougher grunt), #0.81 Rider 1, #0.85 Wing Zero, #0.86 00. Line deliberately trails off; kept unfinished. Identical Japanese kept identical (#0.79 differs only by a missing line break).

#0.89-118 = block C (+88/89+r2), but r2 is REASSIGNED by character id just before it, so the order differs from blocks A/B: 00, Wing Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Zero, Zeta, Black RX, God, Den-O, Rider 1, Nu, Taro, Seven, Ultraman. Confirmed by wording: #0.93 Mebius (honorific on Seravee, polite 'cannot afford to lose'), #0.107/108 Den-O (Momotaros slang), #0.113-118 Taro/Seven/Ultraman (watashi-tachi). The extractor's '?party' labels on #0.89/90 are just the first variant (00).
Mebius: Japanese has no subject; 'we' restored from the parallel lines.
Zeta (#0.102) and God (#0.106): line deliberately trails off ('and yet we, to this much...!!'); kept as a broken-off defiant line.

Speaker = current party leader (CHARA_NAME[r0]); the extractor's '00' label is only the last static value. The script calls only entry 121 (#0.122) with no leader offset, so #0.123-136 are never shown; translated identically anyway.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0731.bla. Leader block #0.89-118 uses a different order from the other blocks (r2 reassigned by character id). #0.123-134 are unreferenced duplicates. No new names or terms.
